title: DEBT30: The copies panel flash guard is shelved by owner ruling
note: Two tests in `app/tests/inventory.spec.ts` are `test.skip`, found by title: `the copies list holds while a new answer moves the walk to another drawer` and `a press to another drawer dims`. Both use `expectCopiesHeld`, which samples every animation frame during a delayed box fetch and asserts no frame lost the copies panel's rows. The owner ruled the guard off. It stays off until the owner rules otherwise.
